input.overview: On io-shop, the saved running total of what each shopper has spent this month fell short of what those shoppers had actually bought. A code change stopped the shop updating that saved total whenever a shopper bought something. The parts of the shop that show and check the total still read the saved figure, so shoppers who bought something this month were shown, and checked against, a figure that was too low. The problem has lasted {duration}. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus suspected a cause, but nothing could tell it within the time it waits whether rolling io-shop back would work. So Argus did not roll back. It recommends rolling io-shop back instead. Argus has also proposed a fix, PR #459, which is open as a draft and has not been applied.
